description: Identify trading cards in a photo with the NeoSatoshi card recognition API. Games: Pokémon (default), One Piece, Disney Lorcana, Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG, Magic: The Gathering, Star Wars: Unlimited and Digimon Card Game (English, Japanese), several cards per photo (binder pages work, one game per photo), and football (soccer) cards with tcg "football" (Topps, Panini and other makers; one card front per photo, max 4 MB). Returns per card: name, language, set, number, rarity, Cardmarket product ID, daily Cardmarket prices in EUR (TCGplayer USD where available), confidence and alternatives. Football cards instead: the player, release (set, number), season, subset, teams, rookie flag, a sure flag, alternatives and the parallel (three candidates with print runs, a pick only when the recognizer is sure; a person should confirm it). No prices and no images for football yet; it takes about 6 to 25 seconds. Digimon (tcg "digimon"): recognised by card number and name; alternative arts share the number, so the printing comes from the picture or stays open (print_unconfirmed) with the printings as alternatives. TCGplayer prices only for English Digimon printings. Older Digimon products (the 1999 card game, the 2000 trading cards) are not recognised. Graded slabs (PSA, BGS, CGC, for football also SGC) fill graded with the grade read from the label. It does not grade card condition. Give exactly one image source: image_path (local .jpg/.jpeg/.png, max 12 MB, football 4 MB), image_url (public https URL, forwarded to the API) or image_base64. Uses the API key in NEOSATOSHI_API_KEY; without it, the public demo key is used (10 detections per day per network). One card usually takes about 4 seconds, about 10 to 12 seconds on the first request after a quiet period; with a progress token the cards are reported one by one while a binder page is read. include_images: true adds the catalog image of up to 10 recognised cards, to compare them with the photo.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded JPEG or PNG (max 12 MB, football 4 MB). A data:image/...;base64, prefix is accepted.

image_path.description: Path to a local JPEG or PNG file (max 12 MB, football 4 MB). Absolute paths work best; ~ is expanded.

image_url.description: Public https URL of a JPEG or PNG (max 12 MB). Sent to the API as is; this server does not download it.

include_images.description: Also return the catalog image of up to 10 recognised cards (small images from our CDN). Default false. Football cards have none.

tcg.description: Which game the photo shows. Default: pokemon. football for football (soccer) cards.

name: recognize_cards
title: Recognize trading cards in a photo
